name: digital-twin-voice
description: Talk to your Digital Twin: open terminals, run commands, open folders, download files and hand tasks to Claude Code by voice.

commands.title: Voice: Open Voice Remote in a Browser Tab
Voice: Type a Command Instead of Speaking
Voice: Log in to Claude Code

enumDescriptions: Best understanding of vague or multi-step requests (default).
Fastest and cheapest; fine for simple commands.
digitalTwinVoice.model.description: Claude model that turns what you say into actions.

enumDescriptions: Browser built-in speech recognition. Free, no key, works in Chrome/Edge/Safari. Weakest on technical words.
OpenAI transcription (gpt-4o-transcribe / whisper). High accuracy. Needs an OpenAI API key.
Deepgram Nova. High accuracy, supports vocabulary hints. Needs a Deepgram API key.
digitalTwinVoice.speech.provider.description: Which speech-to-text engine turns your voice into text.

digitalTwinVoice.speech.language.description: Language code for speech recognition (e.g. en, en-US, lt, de). Leave empty for auto/browser default.

digitalTwinVoice.speech.openaiModel.description: OpenAI transcription model (gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe or whisper-1).

digitalTwinVoice.confirmDangerous.description: Always ask before destructive commands (rm -rf, sudo, git push --force, closing windows, ...), whatever the confirmation mode.

digitalTwinVoice.speakReplies.description: Read short confirmations aloud using the browser's speech synthesis.

digitalTwinVoice.remotePort.description: Local port for the Voice Remote page (opened in a separate browser tab or on your phone through code-server's proxy).

digitalTwinVoice.enabled.description: Master switch. Off hides the Voice panel and status bar item and ignores all voice commands.

enumDescriptions: Only listens after you tap the microphone or press the shortcut (recommended).
Always listens for the wake phrase (e.g. "Hey Twin"), then captures one command.

digitalTwinVoice.listening.wakePhrase.description: Wake phrase for hands-free mode. Two words or more are far less likely to trigger by accident.

digitalTwinVoice.listening.wakeAliases.description: Extra spellings the speech engine tends to produce for your wake phrase (e.g. "hey twins", "a twin").

digitalTwinVoice.listening.endWord.description: Optional word that ends a command immediately (e.g. "over" or "execute"). Leave empty to rely on the pause only. A long pause always works, with or without an end word.

digitalTwinVoice.listening.pauseSeconds.description: Seconds of silence that end a command. Generous by default so you can think mid-sentence.

digitalTwinVoice.listening.autoStart.description: In wake-word mode, start listening automatically when the Voice panel opens. Off means you arm it with the ear button each time.

digitalTwinVoice.listening.chime.description: Play a short tone when the wake phrase is heard and when a command is captured.

digitalTwinVoice.listening.preferOnDevic.description: Use the browser's on-device speech recognition for the wake-word listener when available (Chrome 139+), so ambient audio never leaves your computer.

enumDescriptions: Show what was heard and the planned actions; nothing runs until you say "yes" or tap Confirm.
Show what was heard; run automatically after the countdown unless you say "cancel" or tap Cancel.
digitalTwinVoice.confirmation.mode.description: How much confirmation you want before actions run.

digitalTwinVoice.confirmation.countdownS.description: Countdown length for the countdown confirmation mode.

enumDescriptions: Use an Anthropic API key if one is set, otherwise your Claude account (Claude Code login).
Your Claude account: the same login the `claude` terminal command uses. No API key. About 3 s per command.
Anthropic API key via the Messages API. Fastest (about 1-2 s), billed per use.
digitalTwinVoice.brain.description: What turns your speech into actions.

scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o digital-twin-voice-$npm_package_version.vsix
